note: u west->east, v north->south, fractions of the Argonia heightfield extent (4033x4033 grid, cells -62..63). Owner requirement: all major cities are connected by the road network (see suggestedConnections; master plan §88).

anchors.name: Stormhold
anchors.notes: Northern city, Shadowfen river network, Morrowind-facing.

anchors.name: Thorn
anchors.notes: Northeastern frontier city with delta/river access near the coast.
anchors.role: northeastern frontier city, saltrice estates, Morrowind trade/war

anchors.name: Gideon
anchors.notes: Owner-corrected: sits in the measured saddle of the western border belt (barrier ~46 m vs 60-87 m flanks) where the Cyrodiil road naturally crosses.
anchors.role: western gateway city on the Blackwood Road to Leyawiin

anchors.name: Helstrom
anchors.notes: Owner-corrected northward into the wetland heart (64% of surrounding terrain is 0-6 m marsh).
anchors.role: unconquered heart city, Hist-tribal centre (no outside access)

anchors.name: Archon
anchors.notes: Owner-corrected: mainland east coast (not the offshore island), south of Helstrom and Gideon, north of Lilmoth/Blackrose. Coastal-verified.
anchors.role: eastern port, estuary gateway to the interior, Shadowscale seat

anchors.name: Blackrose
anchors.notes: Owner-corrected: southern lobe directly west of the Lilmoth peninsula, at the edge of the local hills; middle stop of the southern corridor.
anchors.role: lake city over Lilmothiit ruins; Imperial penal institution to its south

anchors.name: Lilmoth

anchors.notes: Owner-corrected: coast of the southern peninsula (coastal-verified; connected to the mainland). Half-sunken Imperial districts (4E 201 state).

anchors.name: Soulrest

nudge.reason: owner feedback round: approved pin was 47% land / 43% buildable (half in the sea); 234 m inland is 84% / 78%, coast 225 m (worldgen.anchor_nudge)

anchors.notes: Owner-corrected: west-south-west coast toward Topal Bay (coastal-verified); western terminus of the southern corridor.

anchors.name: Alten Corimont
anchors.notes: ESO: port in eastern Shadowfen, ESE of the Hatching Pools, run by Argonian pirates/smugglers. Projected east of Stormhold into the measured low wetland corridor (49% of the area is 0-5 m); needs a navigable waterway when hydrology lands.

externalConnections.notes: Canon: Gideon is 'the first settlement on the Blackwood Road, which comes in from the west through the hills that form the southernmost provincial border'. Exits through the measured western pass. Province edges are closed in play (plan §88): the gate is scenery/lore, not a walkable exit.

Canon: Thorn is neighboured by 'Morrowind to the north, toward Tear'; House Dres trade/slave history rides this road. Closed border gate in play. (Stormhold's Shadowfen also borders Morrowind northward but no named road is attested - candidate only.)

suggestedConnections.notes: Southern corridor, western leg; owner requires the three cities to read as one connected corridor.
Shadowfen link; Alten Corimont's overland tie into the network.

Owner-specified western frontier road north from the Gideon pass.

Owner-specified west-east trunk route. The Helstrom-Blackrose road crosses it at a crossroads (candidate site for the community map's 'Crossroads' settlement); both Archon-Helstrom and Gideon-Helstrom travel run via that junction — no direct Helstrom-Archon or Helstrom-Gideon edges exist (owner decisions 2026-08-22).
Heartland-to-south chain; intersects the Archon-Gideon trunk at the crossroads.
Southwestern frontier link along the Topal-facing lowlands; completes ring connectivity in the west.
